decision_rule: smallest min_words whose EXCLUDED bucket on test has F1-macro strictly below the KEPT subset F1-macro (the cut must actually separate quality) AND abstained fraction <= abstain_frac_max; validated descriptively on HC3/OOD (kept-subset human FPR must not exceed full-set human FPR). Coverage constraint rationale: abstention must stay a minority of inputs so the tool remains useful.
mixed_band_rule: p in [lo, hi] around 0.5 is 'mixed/low confidence' where [lo, hi] is the smallest reliability interval on val_cal containing 0.5 whose observed accuracy is < 0.75 (empirical; frozen before test reporting)

validation.note: kept-subset human FPR must not exceed full-set

threshold_policy: 0.5 fixed from Phase 1; never tuned on evaluation data
